reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and encourages viewers to buy paid packages, recruit team members, and pursue bonuses tied to multi-level generations. It combines claims of cryptocurrency appreciation and becoming a millionaire with recruitment-dependent commissions, token splits, and rewards such as cars and luxury items. The presentation is an affirmative sales pitch ending with an immediate call to join, rather than reporting or criticizing the offer.

citations.quote: Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages
The member that joins your team, and with you as a sponsor, will be placed on your right and left side
Depending on what package and status you have, you can earn up to generations of matching bonus and up to 25%
All education packages contain free one tokens

opening.argument: The presentation uses possibility and potential language rather than a categorical promise of profit. It says OneCoin “has the potential” to become attractive and “can be the next Bitcoin,” while describing an Academy intended to teach trading. Even the invitation to become a millionaire is framed as a question, not a guaranteed outcome. The material therefore can be read as an opportunity presentation with optimistic forecasts and educational support, not a representation that every viewer will earn money. Its claims should be assessed as promotional projections whose uncertainty is apparent from the wording.

citations.quote: OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market.
this can be the next Bitcoin
Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?
Through our OneAcademy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats optimistic language as proof of deception, but “potential” and “can be” expressly leave room for uncertainty. The question about becoming a millionaire is aspirational, not a promise. Likewise, mentioning bonuses and packages does not by itself establish that earnings are guaranteed; the cited material describes an opportunity and its conditions.

citations.quote: OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market.
this can be the next Bitcoin
Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications are too limited to change the overall message. The same presentation says the program is “designed to make you profit,” urges viewers to act while the price is low, and says they can profit through token appreciation and splits. Those are not merely neutral forecasts; they connect payment, holding tokens, and recruitment activity to expected financial gain.

citations.quote: All designed to make you profit from owning cryptocurrency.
price is still low and profit from the next cryptocurrency success.
you will profit not only from the price increase but moreover through the split of the token

opening.argument: The central substance can be understood as a financial-technology education presentation. It explains cryptocurrency concepts, trading, price prediction, and investing in gold, and presents interactive videos, presentations, and quizzes. The stated program has five levels and a step-by-step structure, which is characteristic of instruction rather than merely a request for money. The product packages are described as containing Academy educational material, so the viewer is being shown what the training covers and how it is organized. Promotional enthusiasm does not erase the instructional subject matter.

citations.quote: Through our interactive materials such as videos, presentation and online quizzes.
Our program is designed in five levels with a simple step-by-step approach guiding you to success.
All our packages include excellent educational material from our ONE Academy!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side calls the presentation a sales pitch, but that does not answer what viewers are actually shown: a defined Academy curriculum and instructional materials. The presence of package prices can identify how the training is obtained without converting every educational description into a scam endorsement. The presentation also explains trading concepts rather than merely asserting that money should be sent.

citations.quote: Through our OneAcademy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency.
Through our interactive materials such as videos, presentation and online quizzes.
All our packages include excellent educational material from our ONE Academy!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it education does not remove the financial solicitation. The Academy is expressly described as designed to make viewers profit, and the packages are required for bonuses. The curriculum is paired with recruitment, token trading, and a millionaire appeal, so “training” functions as part of the offer rather than a neutral lesson or independent review.

citations.quote: All designed to make you profit from owning cryptocurrency.
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages
Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?

opening.argument: A non-scam reading is that this is an ordinary sale of educational packages that include associated tokens and describe optional rewards. The material lists distinct products and prices, including Starter, Trader, ProTrader, Executive Trader, and Tycoon, and says the packages include Academy material and free tokens. That is a recognizable product-and-service offer. The supplied claims do not state that a fixed return is guaranteed, nor do they request a credential, personal login, or other sensitive information. Recruitment terminology may describe a referral compensation feature, but terminology alone does not prove that the entire offer is fraudulent.

citations.quote: you have to purchase any of our five product packages
Tycoon costs € 5,000. Executive trader costs € 3, ProTrader costs €1000, Trader costs €500, and our Starter is €100!
All our packages include excellent educational material from our ONE Academy!
All education packages contain free one tokens

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening infers a scam from the existence of packages and referral language, but selling education with included tokens is still a commerce model on the supplied record. It does not identify a guaranteed return, a credential request, or a statement that losses are impossible. The cited team language may describe how commissions are calculated, without independently proving that the underlying products are fictitious.

citations.quote: All our packages include excellent educational material from our ONE Academy!
All education packages contain free one tokens
The member that joins your team, and with you as a sponsor, will be placed on your right and left side

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The offer is not merely a retail package. Bonuses require purchasing a package, and the compensation expressly depends on sponsored members, left-and-right placement, multiple generations, and team volume. Those are affirmative features of the earning mechanism, while the absence of a credential request or explicit guarantee does not negate a recruitment-based structure.
